prompts.aim-body-modular: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: supplied clean anime ranger rear over-shoulder aiming illustration. Create a production 2D skeletal-animation BODY ONLY texture on true transparency, square canvas. Preserve head helmet hair headset collar backpack straps, crisp dark line art, olive and tan local colours, existing camera angle and exact head/backpack scale and placement. Remove BOTH arms, gloves and hands completely, including the large sleeve on the right. Redraw the occluded torso beneath the removed arms as a COMPLETE continuous clothed side and chest/back panel with natural seams and harness. The entire side of the torso must be painted solid down to the waist; no arm-shaped transparent holes, no deep scoops, no crescent bites. Shoulder attachment points are small rounded CLOTH shoulder caps, not exposed flesh or sockets. Keep head approximately centered at x40%,y25%, backpack left, waist cropped by bottom edge; torso should extend to x65% near waist to provide generous hidden overlap for independently rigged arms. Preserve original framing; do not zoom or recenter. This is the underlying torso only, no arms, hands or weapon anywhere. No directional rim glow, no 3D render, no text, no labels, no grid.
prompts.ready-body-modular: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: supplied clean anime ranger front three-quarter ready illustration facing right. Create a production 2D skeletal-animation BODY ONLY texture on true transparency, square canvas. Preserve head helmet face mask headset hair collar backpack, tan chest rig with webbing and pouches, waist belt, original crop, crisp dark line art and olive/tan colours. Keep head at original size and position (around x58%,y21%) and preserve leaning pose. Remove BOTH arms and hands completely, including the sleeve crossing in front of chest. Fully redraw the chest rig and clothed torso where the arms used to hide it, as one COMPLETE continuous body silhouette; no arm-shaped holes, no scooped sides, no abrupt diagonal cutout. Draw padded rounded cloth shoulder caps under the future arm roots; no visible skin sockets. Torso from shoulders to waist must remain a solid, coherent illustration under independently rigged arms. Transparent background, no weapon, no arms, no hands, no lettering or grids. Preserve original framing.
prompts.aim-arm-sections: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production 2D skeletal-animation modular arm sprite sheet. Use attached ranger as colour, costume and ink reference ONLY. Draw NEW independent complete parts, NOT polygon pieces chopped out of an assembled body. True transparent background. Exactly 2 equal columns by 3 equal rows, six isolated parts with wide transparent gutters, no text, no labels, no body or head, no weapon or prop. TOP LEFT: entire right upper sleeve segment from rounded padded shoulder cap at top to elbow overlap at bottom, olive cloth, small tan patch and cyan tab; TOP RIGHT: entire left upper sleeve segment, shoulder top elbow bottom, olive fabric no patch. MIDDLE LEFT: right forearm sleeve, rounded elbow at top, black cuff at bottom; MIDDLE RIGHT: left forearm sleeve, rounded elbow at top, black cuff at bottom. Each sleeve vertical, long axis top to bottom, complete contour with closed soft rounded ends extending beyond the joint for overlap, simple coherent folds, no bits of torso/backpack/chest straps. BOTTOM LEFT: tan/black right tactical glove in trigger-grip pose, wrist at lower left and curled fingers upper right around an INVISIBLE vertical grip; no actual gun. BOTTOM RIGHT: tan/black LEFT SUPPORT GLOVE cupping an invisible HORIZONTAL rifle handguard FROM BELOW, palm faces UP, wrist enters from bottom center, four curled fingers rise along the viewer-facing side of the invisible handguard, thumb hooks over opposite side. Handguard slot/opening must be transparent, open toward the top; never draw a fist pointing toward camera or thumb pointing at muzzle. Natural functional underhand support. Both hands are complete separate gloves including cuffs. Crisp strong ink, olive/tan/cyan colours and two-tone cel shadows, same clean anime illustration as reference, no 3D rendering, no highlights baked from a scene. Parts should nearly fill their own grid cells with 12% margins. Top and middle sleeves slender, length about twice width. Viewpoint: rear three-quarter, matching the rear shoulder shooting view; near right sleeve outside/back is visible.
